reference.comparison: Native metadata and equivalent rules; Bevy-specific visual extensions use their own acceptance, without forced pixel parity

excluded_from_acceptance: Concurrent heavy native snow on the integrated GPU received RADV DeviceLost; this failed run is not a pass.
scope_notes: Figures use declared accesses and safe opaque corridors, not a general station navigation mesh.
Jacobs constraints preserve longitudinal momentum; wheel-flange forces are not certified by these frames.
Native crossing rules are conservative occupation/approach rules, not every regional rule.
Frames identify their exact binary and runtime shader hashes; updated fixture lighting does not imply an Open Rails pixel match.
The final owned pickup is beside the car, with a volumetric arm; its paused quarter-open pose was inspected after restore. Fuel/coal/water transfer limits have separate focused simulator tests.

bin_unpacking_lifetime_fix.defect: Source buffers retire dead view/phase keys while the bind-group cache only inserts. Retired groups retain metadata, binned instances, work items and bin-to-indirect-offset buffers.
bin_unpacking_lifetime_fix.order: RenderApp RenderSystems::PrepareBindGroups, after prepare_preprocess_bind_groups and before RenderSystems::Render
bin_unpacking_lifetime_fix.limit: Removes proven retired-view owners. Active instance-buffer capacities and backend allocator reservations can remain high; prolonged stability requires a measured real GPU run.
